previous_notes.text:
17 May 2024 - Dr. H. Martens (GP):
The patient presented with an elevated PSA of 3.5 ng/mL, which had risen from 2.6 ng/mL in May 2023. A prostate biopsy was performed, revealing adenocarcinoma Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2) in the right peripheral zone, with cribriform pattern and intraductal carcinoma (IDC-P) present. The patient was referred to urology for further evaluation and management discussion.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1 (17 May 2024):
Histological examination of the prostate biopsy specimens reveals adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone of the right lobe. High-risk features are present, including cribriform pattern and intraductal carcinoma (IDC-P).

Biopsy timepoint 2 (12 January 2025):
Histological examination of the repeat prostate biopsy specimens reveals adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 4. The growth pattern is cribriform. High-risk features are present, including cribriform pattern and intraductal carcinoma (IDC-P). The tumour is located in the peripheral zone of the right lobe.

Summary: There is histological progression from ISUP grade group 2 to ISUP grade group 4 between the two biopsy timepoints.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): Timepoint 1 — grade group 4; Timepoint 2 — grade group 4.
